tasks.title: The Moon
tasks.statement: The Moon. Determine (for the time of 1 minute after the beginning of your work at the round) and write down in the right boxes:

parts.question: Astronomical azimuth of the Moon (assume the 0° azimuth corresponds to South direction, and the counting is clockwise).
The height of the Moon above the horizon.
Constellation(s) in which the Moon is located (write the standard three-letter designation).
The angular distance between the Moon and a Cas (Shedir).

tasks.title: a Peg (Markab)
tasks.statement: a Peg (Markab). You are provided with a small telescope (80EQ). (Focal length of the telescope: F=900mm; focal length of the eyepiece: f = 20 mm, and apparent field of view: aFoV = 40°). Target and center the telescope on a bright star Markab (a Peg), which magnitude is 2.5". Then observe for the second bright star, HIP 114031, the field of view (FoV).

parts.question: Right is the FoV of the telescope. Plot the position of HIP 114031 relative to a Peg, and mark the directions by Latin letters N, S, E, W (North, South, East and West respectively).
parts.reference: Plot the correct distance (3 points), correct direction (2 points)

parts.question: Estimate the angular distance between these two stars.
